title: Clarice the Cat
moral: Love and care make relationships special.

scenes.summary: Clarice introduces herself and explains she looks different.
scenes.text: Meow I mean Hello I am Clarice the Cat. I know I do not look like a regular cat.
scenes.image_prompt: stylish cat standing in a room introducing herself, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Clarice explains why she looks different from other cats.
scenes.text: It is because my owner makes me a pretty cat. From dressing me in costumes and flowery hats to painting my nails.
scenes.image_prompt: cat wearing colorful costumes and hats with painted nails, playful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Clarice describes how Miss Molly cares for her lovingly.
scenes.text: She always treats me tenderly and feeds me twice a day. Miss Molly is never too busy to sit by me and play.
scenes.image_prompt: girl playing and feeding her pet cat lovingly indoors, warm cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Clarice expresses her strong bond with Miss Molly.
scenes.text: She makes my pretty costumes from old dolls clothes. I never know what I will be wearing but I know it will cause a fuss. Miss Molly is my favorite person. I hope she will always be my friend.
scenes.image_prompt: cat wearing cute costume while girl happily designs clothes, colorful cartoon children's book style

scenes.summary: Clarice ends the story happily, feeling loved and cared for.
scenes.text: I hope she will always be my friend and make me all my clothes. Good Night.
scenes.image_prompt: happy cat in pretty dress saying good night, cozy colorful cartoon children's book style

story: Meow I mean Hello I am Clarice the Cat. I know I do not look like a regular cat. It is because my owner makes me a pretty cat. From dressing me in costumes and flowery hats to painting my nails. She always treats me tenderly and feeds me twice a day. Miss Molly is never too busy to sit by me and play. She makes my pretty costumes from old dolls clothes. I never know what I will be wearing but I know it will cause a fuss. Miss Molly is my favorite person. I hope she will always be my friend and make me all my clothes. Good Night.
